title: 'I Saw Terrorization of the Palestinians': U.S. Congressman Detained by Settlers
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
After being [detained](https://x.com/RoKhanna/status/2075934812334915801?s=20)
by Israeli settlers and soldiers during a Palestinian-led visit to the
occupied West Bank, California Congressman **Ro Khanna** is having to [fend
off](https://x.com/RoKhanna/status/2076834347185828221?s=20) attacks from U.S.
and Israeli officials alike. Democrats, Republicans, and pundits are all
racing to discredit the sitting congressman's visit to the occupied West Bank
for the sake of defending Israel.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

**" You have these two young hoodlums, one with an M4 rifle, [marching
around](https://x.com/RoKhanna/status/2076834347185828221?s=20) our van,
kicking the tires, wiping the windshields, telling us that we can't leave,"**
says Khanna of his encounter with the Israeli settlers. **" It's very
upsetting to me that the American ambassador [Mike Huckabee] isn't looking out
for American citizens."**

Khanna tells **Mehdi** his critics don't want his Palestinian-led trip to set
a precedent for others who might follow his lead and see what he saw, **" the
terrorization of the Palestinians." **Their conversation, which begins with
Khanna's retelling of the story around his detention, also includes:

  * The discrimination he experienced during his trip to the occupied West Bank

  * What shifted his formerly pro-Israel views to where they are today

  * Why he won't criticize Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries, who said he will [vote against](https://x.com/ryangrim/status/2077016809144725725?s=46) Khanna's bill seeking to [stop the fusion](https://zeteo.com/p/e1efd255-7506-4d69-b2d7-c8697e9ba24e) of Israel's military with the U.S.

  * Mehdi's pressing of the congressman on his refusal to call for a full arms embargo to Israel

  * Elon Musk's threat to sue Khanna
